scientific_queries.note: Three-feature advance model with leave-one-cell-out validation on the R78 cell table.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round meets its pre-registered AUC bar, then shows that the operating points are too impure for the decision the AUC might suggest.

design.comparison: B0 alone under the same protocol

key_judgement: the AUC bar was met, but precision never exceeds about 0.50 against a 0.26 base rate, so the model can prioritise which cells to skip yet cannot certify that a cell will not benefit; this is a case where AUC alone would have produced the wrong conclusion
limits: 32 positives in 123 cells makes both the AUC and the precision intervals wide
only three features, with no feature search, to avoid overfitting the small positive class
the threshold 0.2 was read on the same LOO predictions, so the 'flag 55%, recall 94%' point is optimistic without nested validation
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: nested cross-validation (outer leave-one-cell-out, inner threshold selection) to make the triage rule trustworthy
